bagPolicy.summary: Official venue guidance states a maximum bag size of 12 x 12 x 6 inches.
allowed: Bag up to 12 x 12 x 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Metered parking is available on 18th Street. The venue also links to SpotHero for reservations.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Thalia Hall. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Three bars serve drinks. Snacks and hot dogs are available most nights. Bars accept cash and major cards.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Ask door staff for elevator access to the main floor or accessible balcony seating. Opera Boxes require stairs. Email info@thaliahallchicago.com for advance accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed, including after stepping outside to smoke or take a sensory break.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens at doors on show nights and Fridays from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. Opera Box tickets are will call only.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Seated tickets are general admission, and seats are first come, first served when doors open, so arrive early for the best seats or to sit together as a group. Late arrivals are seated at the house manager's discretion.
